$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/cinatra-cli — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. The gate contexts listed here are exactly the ones this repository's main ruleset requires, each carrying the reusable workflow it calls and the sha this repository's own caller workflow pins for it; the truthful-attribution-gate entry additionally carries the callerPath and allowedEvents of that caller (itself a high-risk path), and its pinned sha is the SAME cinatra-ai/ci commit the caller's uses:@ and ref: lines pin — those three sites move together in ONE commit, because the gate compares the resolved run's referenced_workflows[] entry against this sha EXACTLY and a lagging pin fails CLOSED. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (the gate verifies the effective set is a superset; classifyHighRisk fails closed otherwise). High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json and .github/** in the defaults) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-09-15, the birth of this suite on the pull request that adds it: every context it lists — actions-pinned-gate, gitignore-gate, source-leak-gate, secret-scan-gate and truthful-attribution-gate — was read green on that pull request's head, and each pin recorded here equals the sha this repository's own caller workflow pins for that gate at the same head.
